title: From FAIR to AWARE: Data Readiness for Agentic AI in the Earth Sciences
abstract: arXiv:2611.25209v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence in the Earth sciences is beginning to act: prototype agents already search archives, run simulations and draft analyses. Scientific data were curated for researchers who bring expert judgement; an autonomous agent cannot be assumed to supply it. Data can satisfy the FAIR principles and still mislead a machine acting alone. We propose that Earth-science data become AWARE (Actionable, Well-described, Auditable, Recipe-equipped, Epistemically labelled), an agent-specific requirements layer that extends FAIR, within a three-part agenda: AWARE data, bounded tools, layered validation. The ingredients exist across community infrastructure. We outline a staged, measurable path to adoption, intended to reduce silent error.

translated_title: 从FAIR到AWARE：地球科学中面向代理型人工智能的数据就绪性
translated_abstract: 地球科学中的人工智能开始具备自主行动能力：原型智能体已经在检索数据档案、运行模拟并起草分析。科学数据原本是为具有专业判断力的研究人员而整理的，不能假定自主智能体能够自行提供这种判断力。数据即使满足FAIR原则，仍可能误导单独行动的机器。我们提出地球科学数据应当成为AWARE（可操作Actionable、描述完善Well-described、可审计Auditable、配有操作指南Recipe-equipped、认识论上标注Epistemically labelled），即在FAIR基础上扩展的面向智能体的需求层，并围绕三部分议程展开：AWARE数据、有界工具、分层验证。这些要素已存在于社区基础设施之中。我们概述了一条分阶段、可衡量的采用路径，旨在减少无声错误。
tldr: 本文提出在FAIR原则之上扩展的AWARE数据就绪性需求层，为地球科学中自主行动的AI智能体提供专用数据标准与分阶段实施路径，以减少智能体的无声错误。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AWARE, an agent-specific data readiness requirements layer extending FAIR, along with a staged adoption path to make Earth-science data safe for autonomous agentic AI and reduce silent errors.
